votes.motion: Commissioner Brager made a motion to recommend approval of Item 2A with the following conditions: 1. The property be limited to 4 stories above the ground with a height limit of 58 ft. With full underground parking. 2. That the property be age restricted to the extent of the law 3. That there would be more trees for screening between the existing residents and the apartments, with twice the number of trees currently required for the spacing of city street trees. The Clarifications were made on the motion as stated above and were adopted by the commissioner who seconded the motion.

Commissioner Nelson made a motion to recommend approval of item 2b the zone change to add only the proposed use, adolescent stabilization facility and day treatment program, to the use list and adopting all of staff comments and the numerous conditions as listed in the staff report and presentation regarding use, number of people, parking, stay duration 30 days or less, and non-adjudicated patients, etc.
Commissioner Draper made a motion to recommend approval of Auburn Hills Phase 4 as presented to us here and incorporate staff’s comments and conditions.

Commissioner Curtis made a motion to recommend approval of the general plan amendment from low density residential to professional office on approximately three acres generally located at 2046 N Tuweap Drive on both parcels.

Commissioner Brager made a motion to recommend approval of item 3B the new land use designation “Gravel and Grazing” with the condition that we will exclude the words “and processing” adopting the reasoning for the change to the land use designation from the staff report and comments.

Commissioner Brager made a motion to recommend denial of item 3C a General Plan amendment from OS (Open Space), MDR (Medium Density Residential), MHDR (Medium High Density) and IND (Industrial) to (GG) Gravel and Grazing on 49.323 acres.

Commissioner Larsen made a motion to recommend denial of item 3C a General Plan amendment from OS (Open Space), MDR (Medium Density Residential), MHDR (Medium High Density) and IND (Industrial) to (GG) Gravel and Grazing on 49.323 acres.
Commissioner Curtis made a motion to recommend approval of the General Plan amendment from MDR to COM and include staff comments and conditions.

Commissioner Brager made a motion to recommend approval of the changes to the general plan as requested from the Commercial and Low Density Residential to Medium Density Residential and Commercial in the locations represented in the staff report adopting all staff comments and conditions.

Commissioner Nelson made a motion to recommend approval of this CUP for building 100, a 2.5 story professional office building on Lot 5 (called Pad #7) on the Commerce Point Phase 1 plat, adopting the comments and conditions in the staff report which mitigate any detrimental effects of the requested use.

Commissioner Brager made a motion to recommend approval the CUP tower replacement with all of staff comments and conditions listed in the report that mitigate any detrimental effects of the proposed use, and adding: the merging the property, removal of the old tower within the time staff requested, and painting it in a pantone color from the list that staff has for billboards.
Commissioner Nelson made a motion to recommend approval for Item 5A a fifty- nine (59) lot residential preliminary plat for “Auburn Hills Phase 4.”
Commissioner Brager makes a motion to approve the December 10, 2019 meeting minutes.
Commissioner Brager makes a motion to adjourn at 11:40 pm
